Niti is a Sanskrit word derived from the root 'nit', meaning 'rule' or 'direction'. In Hindu mythology, Niti is considered the goddess of righteousness and morality. She is also known as the 'Goddess of Good Conduct'.

Originating from ancient India, Niti is an essential part of Hindu culture and is revered by millions worldwide. Her influence can be seen in various aspects of Hindu society, from the legal system to personal conduct. Niti is also a popular name for girls in the Hindu community, reflecting the importance placed on righteousness and good conduct in Hindu culture.
